job.job_description:
Job Overview




We are looking for a skilled GenAI / LLM Engineer to design and deliver scalable AI solutions leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI frameworks. The ideal candidate will work on cutting-edge AI use cases, building enterprise-grade applications and driving innovation across client environments.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop GenAI solutions including RAG-based applications, chatbots, and automation use cases
Build and integrate LLM-powered APIs and multi-agent workflows
Lead end-to-end implementation from POC to production deployment
Execute LLMOps lifecycle (data prep, model deployment, monitoring, optimization)
Collaborate with clients to identify AI use cases and deliver business solutions
Ensure integration with enterprise systems, especially in BFSI environments
Support chatbots, WhatsApp automation, and voice/vernacular AI solutions
Lead project delivery, ensuring code quality, timelines, and best practices
Mentor team members and drive technical excellence



Required Skills

Strong experience in Generative AI, LLMs, and AI solution development
Hands-on in RAG, Prompt Engineering, and Fine-tuning
Experience with LLMs: OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, LLaMA
Expertise in LangChain (mandatory) and Agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph / CrewAI)
Strong programming skills in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
Experience with FastAPI and REST API integrations
Strong data handling skills with SQL and data engineering concepts
Cloud experience in AWS



Good to Have

Experience with Ollama
Exposure to voice AI / multilingual AI solutions
Domain experience in BFSI
Experience handling teams and client interactions



Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Engineering / Computer Science / Data Science
Masters degree (AI/Data Science) is an added advantag



What We’re Looking For

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Ability to balance innovation with scalability, compliance, and cost
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Leadership mindset with ownership and delivery focus
